title: Junior React Native Developer
description:
We are looking for a **React Native Developer** with 1\.5–2 years of hands\-on experience in **React Native, React.js, Next.js, and TypeScript**.

The candidate will be responsible for developing and maintaining mobile and web applications, integrating APIs, implementing UI designs, troubleshooting technical issues, and collaborating with the UI/UX, backend, and QA teams.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working in a fast\-paced product development environment and be able to take ownership of assigned features and modules.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and maintain cross\-platform mobile applications using **React Native**.
* Build responsive and reusable web applications using **React.js and Next.js**.
* Write clean, scalable, and maintainable code using **TypeScript**.
* Convert Figma designs into accurate and responsive mobile and web interfaces.
* Integrate REST APIs and third\-party services.
* Implement authentication, navigation, forms, validations, and other application features.
* Debug and resolve issues across Android, iOS, and web platforms.
* Optimize applications for performance and responsiveness.
* Work closely with backend developers for API integration and troubleshooting.
* Collaborate with UI/UX designers to ensure accurate implementation of designs.
* Work with QA engineers to identify and resolve bugs.
* Participate in code reviews and follow development standards.
* Maintain Git repositories and follow proper version\-control practices.
* Assist with Android/iOS builds, testing, and application releases.
* Understand existing codebases and contribute to ongoing projects.

Mandatory Skills

* **1–2 years of professional development experience.**
* Strong hands\-on experience with **React Native**.
* Good practical experience with **React.js**.
* Good practical experience with **Next.js**.
* Strong knowledge of **TypeScript**.
* Good knowledge of modern JavaScript / ES6\+.
* Strong understanding of React Hooks and component\-based architecture.
* Experience with REST API integration.
* Experience with responsive web and mobile UI development.
* Good understanding of Git and GitHub.
* Ability to convert Figma designs into functional interfaces.
* Good debugging and problem\-solving skills.
* Knowledge of **Node.js** and backend APIs.
* Knowledge of **MySQL, Postgres**.
* Experience integrating third\-party SDKs and APIs.
* Experience with **Expo / EAS CLI**.
* Experience with **Expo Router / React Navigation**.
* Knowledge of Redux, Zustand, or other state\-management libraries.
* Experience with Firebase.
* Experience with push notifications.

Good to Have

* Experience with deep linking.
* Experience publishing applications to Google Play Store or Apple App Store.

Candidate Expectations

* Strong understanding of frontend and mobile development concepts.
* Ability to work with an existing codebase.
* Ability to independently handle assigned features with reasonable guidance.
* Good attention to UI/UX and implementation details.
* Strong troubleshooting and debugging ability.
* Good communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to meet project timelines and take ownership of assigned tasks.
* Willingness to work across both **mobile and web applications**.

* Health insurance

title: Delightree - Senior Design Engineer
description:
### **About the role**


This role splits roughly in half.


The first half is designing for franchise operations \- multi location brands, franchisee owners, and frontline staff each needing something different from the same product.


The second half is owning the layer between design and code. You'll own the design system \- the components, patterns, and code. You'll write frontend code yourself, and you'll define how design work becomes a shipped interface for everyone else on the team.


That second half is why this role exists. Our approach to product development is shifting. Instead of traditional mockup handoffs, product managers and designers directly build working prototypes directly in code, using AI workflows alongside our component library. Engineering builds on those prototypes rather than starting over. You own this system and ensure it's up to scale and quality.

### **What you'll do**

* Design and build UI in the same motion \- prototyping novel AI\-native interactions directly in code rather than in Figma\-then\-handoff, especially where no pattern library exists yet.
* Sit inside a pod (PM \+ eng lead \+ you) and take features from concept to shipped, rather than handing off a spec and waiting.
* Own the interaction and motion details \- loading/streaming states, transitions, micro\-interactions \- the polish that's nearly impossible to fully spec in a doc.
* Build and maintain shared UI components so the rest of the org can move fast without reinventing patterns feature by feature.
* Work directly in the production codebase.

### **What we're looking for**

* 4\+ years in product design, with depth in dense interfaces \- tables, forms, permissions, multi role flows.
* Real product/visual design judgment *and* the ability to ship real frontend code \- not a designer who dabbles in code or an engineer who cares about UI, but someone for whom design and implementation are the same skill.
* Hands\-on frontend engineering. A portfolio \+ GitHub showing shipped, interactive, polished products \- not just mockups or case studies.
* Design systems built and maintained at scale, in code. You should be able to direct AI tools to build and maintain prototypes that adhere to accessibility, component system, and other guardrails.
* Experience or strong interest in AI\-native interfaces: streaming output, agentic/human\-in\-the\-loop UX, confidence and uncertainty in UI.
* Bonus: has worked somewhere small enough that design and engineering weren't separate functions. AI used structurally in how features got shipped, from ideation through implementation and review \- not just for copy or asset generation.
